description: Audit a Base liquidity pool contract: contract type detection (Uniswap V3/V2, Balancer, unknown), activity level (transaction count), bytecode analysis, and risk flags (no code, low activity, unusual bytecode size). Use for DEX trading pair audits, LP investment screening, and pool existence checks before trading or adding liquidity. Costs $0.03 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
